column1: # Every file install.sh puts on the host, one per line, columns separated by
#   SOURCE  DESTINATION  MODE  OWNER  WHEN  AFTER
# SOURCE       below the repository. *.template is rendered (lib/render.py)
#              with exactly the variables its header declares; others are copied.
# OWNER        user:group; "DECOLAB_USER" stands for the configured user.
# WHEN         always, a setting (HW_FAN, HW_OLED, HW_NVME, HW_UPS: as detected;
#              HARDENING: if yes) or late: placed after the stacks run, and
#              only once the restore is confirmed or there is nothing to
#              restore (the schedules: a nightly backup of a half restored
#              system would push the good copies out).
# AFTER        what has to happen once if the file changed: tmpfiles,
#              with visudo before and after) or - for nothing.
# install.sh records the checksum of every file it wrote in
# /var/lib/decolab/installed.tsv. A file still as written is updated when the
# repository changes it (the old one is kept as FILE.decolab-old); a file
# someone changed is never overwritten: install.sh shows the difference.
